title: Featured Projects

projects.title: Call Intelligence: Voice Analytics Pipeline
projects.description: Enterprise-grade multi-region batch & streaming data pipeline ingesting and analyzing Amazon Connect Contact Lens voice transcripts across 5 global regions (EU, NAM, LATAM, APAC, MEA) into a Medallion Lakehouse.
highlights: Engineered 3-tier Medallion architecture (Bronze ➔ Silver ➔ Silver Plus) on Databricks & Delta Lake
Implemented PySpark Structured Streaming with Delta Change Data Feed (CDF) & version watermarking
Extracted sentiment quartiles, talk-to-listen ratios, and conversation metrics with schema drift protection

projects.title: GitHub Developer Suite & Privacy Manager
projects.description: A modern, privacy-first web tool for developers to manage repository visibility in bulk, enforce branch protection rules, inject CI/CD workflows, manage access control, and automate repository maintenance.
highlights: Zero-Trust client-side architecture executing direct REST API requests to GitHub with zero backend storage
Bulk repository visibility conversion, bulk archival, branch protection enforcement, and topic tagging
Automated GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow and Dependabot template injection across repositories

projects.title: AI Smart Attendance Management System
projects.description: Computer vision-powered desktop application that automates classroom attendance using real-time facial recognition, multi-role access control (Admin, Faculty, Student), and comprehensive audit trails.
highlights: Automated multi-face detection and continuous recognition with confidence scoring and unknown-face logging
Three complementary attendance workflows: live camera recognition, teacher 1-click marking, and student self-marking
Built-in timetable scheduling, leave management workflow, attendance locking, and role-based access control

Automated CI/CD deployment pipeline via GitHub Actions to GitHub Pages
